coach_board.error.coach_role.text: Someone on the board no longer has the coach role. Discard your changes and try again.

coach_board.error.team_not_found.text: A team on the board no longer exists. Discard your changes and try again.

coach_board.error.too_large.text: The board holds too many assignments.

coach_board.error.two_heads.text: A team can have only one head coach.

coach_board.intro.text: Drag coaches from the pool onto teams, or pick them with Add coach. A coach can be on several teams and a team can have several coaches. Nothing is saved until you press Save.

coach_board.no_assignments.text: No coaches are assigned in this season yet.

coach_board.no_coaches.text: The group has no coaches yet.

coach_board.no_js.text: Without JavaScript, choose coaches in the Add coach lists and press Update board, or use the coaches card on each team page.

coach_board.no_teams.text: The group has no teams yet.

coach_board.pool_help.text: Drag a coach onto a team. Drag a coach from a team back here to take them off.

coach_board.read_only.text: Admins and managers assign coaches; you see the saved assignments read only.

coach_board.reason.qualification.one: Qualified for ages {min}–{max}, {count} team so far
coach_board.reason.qualification.other: Qualified for ages {min}–{max}, {count} teams so far

coach_board.saved.text: Coach assignments saved: {added} added, {removed} removed, {head} head coach changes.

coach_board.stale.text: The coach assignments changed since you opened the board. Discard your changes to see the current ones.

coach_board.start_over_confirm.text: Replace the whole board with a new suggestion? Unsaved changes are lost.

coach_board.suggest_help.text: Suggest fills teams without a coach: the team's coaches from the previous season first, then a qualified coach with availability and the fewest teams. It saves nothing and keeps what is on the board.

coach_board.suggested.one: {count} suggestion added. Review it and save.
coach_board.suggested.other: {count} suggestions added. Review them and save.

coach_board.suggested_none.text: Nothing to suggest: every team has a coach, or no qualified coach is left.

coach_board.warning.qualification_mismat.text: Qualified for ages {min}–{max}, the team is {team_min}–{team_max}
